title: Country Jam @ Guitars and Cadillacs
event_description: Monthly country jam session featuring Kansas City's best musicians. Bring your instrument or vocal skills to play at this iconic venue where legends have performed.
event_time_plain: First Sunday of each month 9:00 PM - 1:00 AM
event_venue_information:
Guitars and Cadillacs Country Jam

This legendary venue has been the home of Kansas City country music for decades. The iconic stage has hosted performances by Garth Brooks Toby Keith Brooks & Dunn and Alan Jackson early in their careers. The Country Jam Night on the first Sunday of each month is a true musician's jam where players from around the region gather to celebrate country music and Southern rock. The venue features a full bar food service and a spacious dance floor.

title: Open Mic @ The Piano Room
event_description: Wednesday night open mic featuring guitar piano poetry and comedy. All musical styles welcome - this is a traditional piano bar with an inclusive LGBTQ+ friendly atmosphere and decades of live music tradition.
event_venue_information:
The Piano Room - Kansas City's Traditional Piano Bar

Opened in 1978 originally as Inge's this intimate venue has become a Kansas City institution for live piano and open mic performances. The Piano Room is known as a welcoming space for singers and musicians of all backgrounds. The venue features nightly entertainment including karaoke and live piano. Wednesday night open mic is the signature event where performers bring guitars poetry comedy and vocal performances. The bar is an inclusive LGBTQ+ friendly space that welcomes all music lovers.

title: Live Music @ BrewTop Overland Park
event_description: Contemporary live music venue with diverse artists performing rock country blues and pop covers. Features PA system and full bar with food service.
event_venue_information:
BrewTop Pub and Patio - Live Music Venue

This spacious venue is a popular hangout featuring live music several nights per week. BrewTop offers a large selection of beers craft cocktails and pub food with an extended kitchen open until 1:30 AM. The venue is known for hosting quality live bands covering rock country blues and pop. Large TVs throughout make it great for sports and entertainment. Features both indoor and outdoor patio space making it ideal for groups and celebrations.

title: Open Mic Jam @ Last Call Speakeasy
event_description: Friday and Saturday evening live music at this prohibition-era themed cocktail lounge. Features singer-songwriters and acoustic performances in an intimate upscale setting.
event_venue_information:
Last Call Speakeasy - Prohibition-Era Cocktail Lounge

Hidden behind an unmarked door this intimate speakeasy blends prohibition-era intrigue with modern cocktail craft. The venue features expertly crafted experimental cocktails with molecular techniques and refined tapas. The warm low-lit space hosts live music on Friday and Saturday nights featuring singer-songwriters and acoustic performers. Perfect for intimate gatherings celebrations and special events with a private events team available.

title: Live Music @ Louie's Wine Dive 119
event_description: Casual live music performances featuring singer-songwriters and acoustic artists. Great wine selection craft cocktails and locally sourced cuisine in an elegant casual setting.
event_venue_information:
Louie's Wine Dive and Kitchen 119 - Wine Bar and Music Venue

This award-winning restaurant and wine bar celebrates great wine locally sourced cuisine and live music. The venue features an extensive wine list with selections from small undiscovered vineyards around the world. Award-winning chefs prepare made-from-scratch menus daily. Live music performances feature singer-songwriters and acoustic artists creating an intimate atmosphere. Louie's Wine Dive offers weekend brunch craft cocktails and a casual elegant vibe perfect for music lovers and food enthusiasts.
